name: Akki Roti
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine rice flour, chopped onions, dill leaves, grated carrot, green chilies, cumin seeds, and salt.
2. Gradually add warm water and knead into a soft, non-sticky dough.
3. Grease a flat pan (tawa) or a banana leaf with oil.
4. Take a ball-sized portion of the dough and pat it evenly with wet fingers into a thin, circular roti directly on the pan.
5. Make a small hole in the center of the roti, drizzle a little oil around it, and cook on medium heat covered with a lid.
6. Flip and cook until golden brown spots appear on both sides.
description: Akki Roti is a staple breakfast dish from Karnataka, known for its unique texture and healthy combination of rice flour and fresh greens. It is traditionally served hot with spicy coconut chutney or butter.
